Privacy Policy
Privacy Policy Last updated: September 5, 2025
At Central United Cooperative ("we", "our", or "us"), we are committed to protecting your personal data and respecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your information when you visit our website at https://centralunitedcoop.com .
1. Who We Are
Central United Cooperative provides agricultural services and products to communities and businesses. Our website is designed to share information, offer customer support, and provide tools such as contact forms and job applications.
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, you can contact us at: Email: info@centralunitedcoop.com
2. What Data We Collect
We may collect the following personal data from you:
Name
Email address
Phone number
Resume and job application data (when applying for a job)
IP address and browser information (via cookies and analytics)
Any other information you voluntarily submit via our forms
3. How We Collect Your Data
We collect personal data in the following ways:
When you fill out contact or inquiry forms
When you submit a job application
Through cookies and similar tracking technologies
Through third-party tools like Google Analytics
4. Why We Collect Your Data
We use your personal data for the following purposes:
To respond to your inquiries and provide customer support
To review and process job applications
For marketing and communication purposes
To understand website usage and improve performance (analytics)
We rely on your consent, our legitimate business interests, or the need to perform a contract as the legal bases for processing your personal data under GDPR.
5. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
We use cookies and similar technologies to:
Improve website functionality and performance
Analyze visitor behavior using Google Analytics
Provide a tailored user experience
When you first visit the website, you will see a cookie consent banner allowing you to accept or decline non-essential cookies.
6. Sharing Your Data
We may share your data with trusted third-party service providers, such as:
Google Analytics (for website traffic analysis)
WP Engine (our website hosting provider)
Email marketing platforms (if used)
These third parties process your data on our behalf and are bound by data protection agreements to ensure your information is handled securely and in compliance with GDPR.
We do not sell your personal data.
7. International Data Transfers
Some of our third-party service providers (such as Google and WP Engine) may transfer data outside the European Economic Area (EEA), typically to the United States.
When this occurs, we ensure that adequate safeguards are in place, such as:
Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission
Provider participation in recognized frameworks or certifications
8. Data Retention
We retain your personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes it was collected, including:
To fulfill any legal, regulatory, tax, accounting, or reporting requirements
For internal analysis (limited time for analytics data)
Until you withdraw your consent (for marketing communications)
9. Your Rights Under GDPR
As a data subject under the GDPR, you have the following rights:
Access – You can request access to your personal data
Correction – You can request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
Erasure – You can ask us to delete your data
Objection – You can object to how we use your data
Restriction – You can ask us to limit processing of your data
Portability – You can request your data in a structured, machine-readable format
Withdraw Consent – You may withdraw your consent at any time (e.g., for marketing emails)
To exercise your rights, contact us at: info@centralunitedcoop.com
10. Data Security
We take appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, including:
SSL encryption (HTTPS)
Access control and secure hosting via WP Engine
Limiting access to data to authorized personnel only
11. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the “Last updated” date at the top of this page.
We encourage you to review this page regularly to stay informed about how we are protecting your data.
12. Contact Us
If you have any questions or requests related to your personal data or this Privacy Policy, you can contact us at:
Email: info@centralunitedcoop.com
